_comment: Shared cross-language vectors for flattening IfcPresentationStyleAssignment on an IFC2X3/IFC4 -> IFC4X3 conversion (#7742, D57). IFC4X3's IfcStyledItem.Styles takes IfcPresentationStyle directly, so each Styles entry naming an assignment is replaced by the assignment's members (order kept, deduplicated) and the assignment records are not written. `records` are the DATA records in; `expect` the records written, in order. Rust: rust/export/tests/schema_style_flatten_parity.rs (export_step_json). TypeScript: packages/export/src/schema-style-flatten.parity.test.ts (StyleFlatten + convertStepLine). Scope: infrastructure IFC4X3 -> IFC4 stays fail-closed.

cases.why: a styled item naming an assignment gets the assignment's members; the assignment is not written
an assignment BEFORE its styled item flattens the same
members are deduplicated across assignments with first-seen order kept
a direct style member keeps its place beside an assignment, and a repeat of it collapses
an assignment nobody names is still not written
IFC4X3 Styles takes IfcPresentationStyle entities only: a typed IFCNULLSTYLE member is dropped (D59)
an assignment holding only a null style leaves an empty Styles list (D59; the schema wants one member, the null style has no IFC4X3 spelling)
control: the IFC2X3 target keeps its assignments
control: IFC4X3 -> IFC4 has no assignment to flatten
